# Handover Player

> Video review for teams that already use Dropbox. Paste a Dropbox link, get a shareable review page with frame-accurate timecode comments — no re-uploads, no new accounts, no per-seat fees.

## What this is

Handover Player is a web-based video review tool aimed at small video production teams. It plays Dropbox-hosted video directly (no re-upload), locks every comment to a precise timecode, supports realtime multi-reviewer collaboration, and exports markers to Premiere Pro XML or DaVinci Resolve CSV for NLE integration.

- Frontend: React 19 + Vite 7
- Styling: Tailwind CSS v4
- Backend: Supabase (Postgres + Realtime)
- Deploy: Vercel
- License: MIT

Designed by DELAX Studio for video producers who hand off cuts for review across producer/editor/director — hence "Handover."

## Key features

- Dropbox direct playback (4K, long-form, no proxy)
- Frame-accurate comments anchored to timecode
- Realtime collaboration (no refresh)
- NLE-style keyboard shortcuts (Space/K/J/L, 1-4 speed, M, F, C)
- Export: Premiere Pro XML sequence markers, DaVinci Resolve CSV timeline markers (supports 23.976, 29.97 DF, etc.)
- Folders & episodes for multi-episode projects
- Share by link — reviewers do not need accounts

## What this is NOT

- Not a video storage/CDN service — Dropbox is the storage layer
- Not an editor — it's review-only, output goes back into Premiere or Resolve
- Not enterprise SaaS — designed for solo creators and small teams, not org-wide rollout
- Not transcoding or proxy generation — relies on Dropbox-served originals
